messages:
Ana (Sales): Heads-up — AtlasPay just dropped a SIG/CAIQ and asked for a POC + pricing comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated). Upload attached. Can someone own intake + the initial questionnaire answers? POC kickoff next week.
Mike (Security): I can triage. Can you paste the link and call out any regs they flagged (PCI, SOC2, etc.)?
Ana (Sales): Link: https://drive.redwood/secure/atlaspay/AtlasPay_SIG_CAIQ_v1.pdf. They explicitly called out PCI and want KMS for keys. POC is internal demo next week; they also want a 1-page security summary for procurement and pricing ranges for Dedicated vs Hosted.
security-bot: File uploaded to security intake queue: /intake/1729876543/AtlasPay_SIG_CAIQ_v1.pdf. Status: untriaged.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I can own the technical Qs for the POC. Need model usage estimates + sample prompts. @Ana what concurrency and avg tokens should I assume for capacity calc?
Ana (Sales): Target is ~10 concurrent sessions for the demo, avg ~180 tokens per request, bursts up to ~50 concurrent. Budget note: they're comparing $/token and SLAs; may push for Dedicated if numbers justify.
Mike (Security): Reassigning for ownership: Security owner will be me; tech owner @Liam. Please tag individual questionnaire items as Q1/Q2 so we can track. I'll pull the CAIQ matrix and start filling control responses.
Mike (Security): ```
Owner: Liam (Solutions Eng)
Security Owner: Mike (Security)
Status: In progress
Due: 2024-06-25
Outstanding: KMS integration, key rotation cadence, network segmentation controls, proof of PCI scoping
```
Jules (Customer Success): FYI — procurement asked for a one-page security summary they can hand to legal. Can we produce that by EOD tomorrow? Short bullets preferred.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the tech appendix and a short POC runbook (model variant, batching, sample prompts, recommended infra). Recommendation: Dedicated for predictable low-latency; Hosted with VPC peering is an alternative for short POCs.
Ana (Sales): Quick question for security: for KMS, do we need on-prem HSM or would cloud KMS (with proper key separation) be acceptable for PCI in this case?
Mike (Security): Cloud KMS is acceptable with proper audit logs and separation; on-prem HSM usually only required for highest-assurance customers. I'll flag key separation and rotation requirements in answers and loop infra.
security-bot: Status changed: triaged -> owner assigned (Liam). Labels added: pci, kms-required, poc.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Draft answers uploaded: https://internal.redwood/doc/atlaspay-sig-answers-v1 — added partial CAIQ responses and POC config notes. Need @Mike to confirm crypto and control language.
Mike (Security): Reviewing now. Two outstanding items I see: 1) KMS rotation cadence — customer asked monthly; we support rotation but need to confirm automation and evidence. 2) PCI scope — confirm we do NOT persist PAN; include data flow diagram (I'll add).
Tess (Finance): Pricing note: for short-term POC, Hosted is typically cheaper. Dedicated uplift vs Hosted is roughly 2.2x–2.8x per-token depending on term/commit. If they commit 12+ months, Dedicated unit cost improves significantly.
Jules (Customer Success): Great — can someone put a single-line pricing summary I can paste? Procurement expects a ballpark.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Ballpark: Hosted POC estimate = $0.XX/token (depends on model), Dedicated reserved capacity estimate = ~2.5x hosted for short term; can refine with expected qps.
Mike (Security): I'll draft the one-page security summary and mark Q1–Q15 in the CAIQ answers. @Liam please add the infra config details. Expect a completed packet by EOD tomorrow.
Ana (Sales): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Please update this thread when the final packet is uploaded so I can forward to AtlasPay procurement. If any blockers, ping me immediately.
Jules (Customer Success): Noted. Will coordinate follow-up calls if procurement wants a walkthrough.
Mike (Security): Adding note for infra team: need confirmation on KMS automation + audit evidence. cc @infra (not in this thread).
